glossary.definition: (A) "Assuming insurer" means an insurance company that accepts all or part of the risk underwritten by a ceding insurer.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3901.61 to 3901.65 of te Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3901.61 - Credit for reinsurance ceded definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Ceding insurer" means an insurance company that transfers all or part of the risk it underwrites to an assuming insurer.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3901.61 to 3901.65 of te Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 3901.61 - Credit for reinsurance ceded definitions.
